claims.text: clicks_per_eligible_day (recorded clicks / eligible day): Personal mean changed from 2.79 in weeks 0–3 (4 observed weeks) to 0.25 in weeks 8–11 (4 observed weeks): change -2.54 recorded clicks / eligible day. This descriptive personal change has no uncertainty interval.

clicks_per_eligible_day (recorded clicks / eligible day): Focal mean 2.79; peer mean 13.04; difference -10.25 recorded clicks / eligible day, focal weeks 0–3. 237 distinct peers / 944 person-weeks; 4 observed focal weeks. Reference: AAA_2013J: Other development people in this presentation, excluding all task focal people; reference weeks 0–3. Peer mean 95% bootstrap interval [11.82, 14.52]; not an individual prediction interval.

compiler_supplied_context: Recorded clicks are not effort, ability, learning or study time; logging completeness is unknown.
Registration approximates opportunity, not actual exposure. The withdrawal day is the first ineligible day.
Assessment scores and banked credit are withheld: grade-release and banking-approval times are unknown.
Scheduled assessments are opportunities, not verified individual obligations; exemptions may be unobserved.
Source interaction rows can repeat; sums preserve all source rows and are not verified unique click events.
Peer means describe eligible observed person-weeks; changing eligibility and informative withdrawal can change composition.
Exploratory development analysis only; no causal, significance, anomaly or prediction claim.
Earlier-stage references answer a different question; they are not automatically fairer or causally adjusted.
All task focal people are excluded from the shared development peer pool.
conclusion: Descriptive results; no claim that the interpretation changes across references.
numeric_values_origin: analytical results only; model schema accepts no arbitrary numbers/text
